start_matrix_server: start a FastAPI server on port 6289 to manage Matrix clusters and jobs via HTTP endpoints
submit_job: submit a new job with task definitions to the Matrix JobManager via the POST /jobs endpoint
evaluate_checkpoint: submit a checkpoint evaluation job that runs benchmarks on a model checkpoint across multiple seeds
start_cluster: start a new Ray cluster with optional Slurm or local worker configuration via the POST /start-cluster endpoint
get_checkpoint_eval_metrics: get the status and benchmark statistics for a checkpoint evaluation job by its job ID
